name: 23112 · Midlothian, VA
findings: ZIP 23112 (Midlothian) has 142 nonprofit organizations. 62 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 48 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23112 (Midlothian) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: 2 social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 9 would.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through social and fraternal groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.text: 18 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
